diagnostics.alpha_selection: maximum validation Macro-F1; ties nearest 0.5 then smaller alpha
diagnostics.parameter_gradients: not collected in eval/no_grad; probe records training gate gradients separately

variants.E3a: Remove only the two post-gate entropy-proxy mixing/normalization statements; retain every learned gate input, including entropy/margin/cosine. Fresh paired initialization.
variants.E3a_equal_init: Same pure-gate forward as E3a; additionally zero the gate final Linear weight/bias AFTER original paired initialization. All other tensors and random states unchanged. Requires completed E3a screening first.

screening.test: disabled; no test graph loader or inference
screening.probe_initial_gradient_check: nonzero aggregate gate gradient; zero upstream gate gradient on the very first equal-init step is allowed

budget.enforcement: record elapsed time, estimate after first 2-3 epochs, and do not add jobs beyond budget; no automatic kill or partial-run performance claim

scheduling: Linux server only. Metadata check does not import torch. No local models, automatic GPU choice, preemption, automatic probe-to-screen chain, new graph/split, or edits to frozen sources. Occupied GPU needs explicit --allow-shared-gpu; snapshots are not reservations.
